senses.definition: A summary of topics which will be covered during an academic course, or a text or lecture.
senses.example: In the first half of the year, teachers attended the training workshop for the new K-10 Chinese syllabus. In July, almost all the teachers attended the teacher training courses provided by OCAC.

senses.definition: The headnote of a reported case; the brief statement of the points of law determined prefixed to a reported case.
